The '''Traptoforia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Thrasybule sector/Legends|Thrasybule sector]], which was a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Traptoforian razor slug]]s.<ref name="LSatSoM" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Traptoforia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square P-6.<ref name="TEA" />
